newsitem.title: UK: Encyclopedia publisher Helicon plans July float.
newsitem.headline: Encyclopedia publisher Helicon plans July float.

text.p: Helicon Publishing, best known for the Hutchinson Encyclopedia, said on Tuesday it planned to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market(AIM)in July.
The Oxford-based group said it hoped to raise about three million stg from the float and would use the proceeds for expansion and the acquisition of new publishing assets.
The market capitalisation of Helicon, which publishes reference material from its databases in the form of books and CD-ROM, was expected to be between eight and 10 million stg at the issue date.
On-line services such as CompuServe, America Online and Microsoft Corp also access its databases, the company said.
The publisher said sales had risen to 3.5 million stg for the year end March 31 1997 from 2.4 million stg the previous year. Pre-tax profits for the year to March 31 1997 were 101,000 stg.
